title: Constitution (One Hundred and Thirtieth Amendment) Bill, 2025
summary: Would remove a Prime Minister, Chief Minister, or minister who is arrested and detained for thirty days on charges carrying death or life imprisonment. A joint parliamentary committee is still considering the bill and has proposed modifications, including reinstatement if the case ends. The committee's tenure was extended on 31 July 2026 so it can report by the Winter Session, and news reports from November 2026 say the committee is set to adopt its report.

title: Constitution (One Hundred and Thirty-first Amendment) Bill, 2026
summary: Delimitation package tied to implementing the women's reservation law: it would have raised the Lok Sabha's maximum strength to 850 and enabled immediate delimitation. Defeated in Lok Sabha on 17 April 2026 with 298 votes, short of the special majority; the companion delimitation bills were withdrawn. News reports from November 2026 say the government plans a fresh delimitation linked amendment bill for the Winter Session expected in December 2026.
